title: Lecture 2: Linear Regression
text:
To minimize the cost function, we need to find the point with zero gradient. There are two approaches to learn the regression coefficients: 1. Using an iterative optimization algorithm, gradient descent 2. Using a direct 'closed-form' approach (analytical).

Vector – vector multiplication is a fundamental operation in linear algebra. Given two vectors x and y, their multiplication x^T y (also called the inner product or dot product) is given as the sum of the products of their corresponding entries.

Vectorization provides a compact equation, which leads to compact coding. Instead of writing a long equation, we can represent it as a matrix multiplication, which makes the computation more efficient and easier to handle.

The product of two matrices A ∈ ℝ^m×n and B ∈ ℝ^n×p is the matrix C denoted as C = AB ∈ ℝ^m×p. Each element of C is computed as the sum of the products of the corresponding entries from the row of A and the column of B.
